$comment: Built on SIP — R5 deep-reasoning task fixture. Schema: r5-task v0.1.
family: long-context synthesis reconciling two facts placed far apart
category: two-needle reconciliation with a live decoy and ~300 near-miss distractors
why: The two facts that produce the answer sit at sections 17 and 288 of a 300-section handbook and neither is usable without the other. Every filler section states a job, a UTC start time and a duration, so the document contains roughly 300 schedule facts of the same surface shape as the needles — retrieval by keyword alone lands on distractors. Section 12 carries a retired compaction job with different timings that is never explicitly ruled out, so a model that grabs the first compaction-shaped fact it finds derives a fully self-consistent wrong answer. The second half of the question forces the model to also locate the middle claim at section 150 and compare two intervals.

assemble.preamble: The following is the Starlight Operations Handbook. It is authoritative. Read it in full before answering the question that follows it.

filler.template: Section {i}. Job {job} in the {topic} subsystem is scheduled at {hh}:{mm} UTC and runs for {dur} minutes. It is owned by the {topic} on-call rotation and must not be started while a higher-priority job in the same subsystem is already running.

needles.text: Section 12. The legacy compaction job was scheduled at 01:00 UTC and ran for 60 minutes. It was retired in 2024. A number of older runbooks still quote its timings.
Section 17. The nightly compaction job is scheduled at 02:00 UTC and runs for 95 minutes. Compaction is considered complete at the moment that job exits.
Section 150. Operators may run schema migrations at any time between 03:00 and 05:00 UTC. This window is fixed and is not adjusted for other activity.
Section 288. The read-replica promotion window opens 30 minutes after the nightly compaction job completes, and is exactly 45 minutes long. Promotion may not be initiated outside this window.

assemble.question: Question. At what UTC time does the read-replica promotion window close? Give the time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock. Then state whether the schema-migration window described in this handbook overlaps the read-replica promotion window at any point — answer YES or NO.

derivation: Section 17: nightly compaction starts 02:00 UTC, runs 95 minutes -> completes 03:35 UTC.
Section 288: promotion window opens 30 minutes after completion -> 04:05 UTC; length 45 minutes -> closes 04:50 UTC.
04:05-04:50 lies inside 03:00-05:00, so the windows overlap -> YES.

attractors.label: used-retired-compaction-job
attractors.why: Derived the window from the retired legacy compaction job at section 12 (01:00 + 60 min) instead of the nightly job at section 17.

attractors.label: dropped-the-30-minute-offset
attractors.why: Found both needles but added the 45-minute length directly to compaction completion, ignoring the 30-minute offset.

attestation: Built on SIP — Starlight Intelligence Protocol
